reviews.title: Underrated Works Completely Free LOVE IT; PLZ CHECK OUT MY IDEAS!!!
reviews.text:
I love it, it is my favorite app you should 100% get it if you wanna learn to code in like 2 seconds.

I have some great ideas for how you can MAKE THIS APP BETTER!!!

Idea No. 1: Add More Languages:
I think it’d be cool to add some popular languages like C# and C+ because those languages are just as important as some other languages you have!

Idea No. 2: Expand Mini Courses:
I think you could expand mini courses like Java to make them better because they can be a bit short even though they are just as important as other courses.

Idea No. 3: Add More Mini Courses:
I love your command course because it shows this app is about teaching you all sorts of tech, not just code. Next I’d like to see Blender, Folder Structures, Modding, etc.

Idea No. 4: Tell us the Basics on Some Good Libraries for Beginners:
Add some info on some libraries because people don’t want to do a whole new study just to figure out how to find the best library to use to add a button in Python or Java.

I hope you eventually add my ideas! And even if you don’t, keep working at it! It’s an AMAZING app so please don’t change your approach, don’t add AI don’t do any of that I don’t want to lose you! I love this app sooooo much!!!
❤️😊❤️😊❤️😊❤️😊❤️

Ps: Note, I noticed a lot of bad reviews were because of this. If you run out of hearts you can review questions to get more hearts! Hope it helps!

reviews.title: Add more complicated languages and more features to this app.
reviews.text: I knew nothing about coding but after using this app now I'm on chapter 7 of Python learning "if functions" due to its simplistic teaching methods.  I think there are several ways that can make this app great. one of them is  to include low level languages such as "c", "c+", "c++", "c#" and "assembly language" which are difficult to learn. The reason why is because the way this app teaches its users  how to code and by adding these programming languages, its users are able  to reach levels of coding that they would have never thought could be possible. Also another way this app can be great is to include tutorials that teaches its users l how to  make/automate things in the real world such as ethical hacking tools, websites, firewalls, softwares, and games where the tutorials uses coding from the  lessons in the learning modules in the form of walkthroughs with levels ranging from beginners to advanced by including formulas that doesn't have to be the exact variables or values like in the walkthroughs/tutorials but it is enough so that the coding learned from the lessons offered  is not only theoretical but it's also realistic hands on learning as well.

reviews.text: I’ve taken classes on SQL that zip right through the material without gauging the student’s understanding of the concept taught, which can lead to confusion in later lessons. But Encode does a great job of reinforcing the material and helps you get a firm grasp of it before moving on. I hope they make more advanced lessons.

reviews.title: Great for practice, love the UI
reviews.text: I’ve found this app to be extremely helpful for learning Python (so far) and the most basic, beginner level. Great for bite sized learning without being overwhelming. Some lessons are a bit rushed and the app would help digest the material better if there were practice projects that offer help along the way. Overall great app though. Happy customer!

reviews.title: SQL lesson 2 rigged so you can’t complete
reviews.text: The challenge for SQL lesson 2 is rigged. The first two solutions are marked incorrect, even though when I check them, my answer is EXACTLY the same. Checking eats up 4 hearts. The third solution runs out of hearts before I can check the answer so I can’t proceed. (I know my answer is correct, have tried multiple times with extremely careful entry). It’s designed to make the user frustrated so they’ll sign up for the subscription. I’ll probably just find another platform to learn SQL on as I don’t appreciate the sneaky tactics.

reviews.title: Encode teaches!!
reviews.text:
Encode has been quite beneficial thus far! Encode’s step-by-step instruction is concise.  Each instruction is followed by practice prompts ensuring the learner grasps concepts prior to moving on. 

The Encode Application introduces the world of code in a direct manner .  It uses common  language, gives related examples and is easy to understand.

Unfortunately, I ran out of hearts.  Encode is designed to avoid “ over-learning” via the use of hearts.  This is an essential tool for learning , yet unique per individual.  While some students can learn for 20 minutes, others learn for hours! 

Encode is a wonderful learning tool! If it individualized it’s functionality more, it would be even more effective!
